scripts.preinstall: node -e "const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if(!ua.startsWith('npm/')){ console.error('Use npm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.dev:next: concurrently -n web,api -c magenta,green "npm run dev:next -w niku-next" "npm run dev -w @workspace/api-server"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:single-hosting: npm run build -w niku-next && npm run build -w @workspace/api-server
scripts.deploy:single-hosting: npm run build:single-hosting && npm run start:single-hosting
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
